meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 激活高强度工作模式,让 AI 助手在会话中遵循你的全部规则。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你使用 Codex 编程,并希望 AI 严格按你的规则执行。
copy.tagline_en: Turn on power mode to make the AI follow all your rules for the rest of the task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want your AI to strictly follow your working guidelines.

howto.what: 触发后,Claude 会进入 ultrawork 模式:先声明模式开启,再定目标、记进度、列待办;动手前须先写一个会失败的检查,完成时用真实运行结果证明,不只靠嘴上说。
howto.when: 当你的话里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式,修复登录接口的 bug。
say.note: Claude 会先写失败检查,修好后附运行证据。

say.text: 启动 ulw,给订单模块加一条校验规则。
say.note: 它会按流程规划、记进度、逐步完成。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式重构这段代码,并证明行为不变。
say.note: 会先锁定旧行为,再重构并验证。

howto.what_en: When you say the trigger, Claude enters ultrawork mode: it declares the mode, sets a goal, logs progress, and keeps a checklist. It must first write a failing check, then implement, and finally prove completion with real runtime evidence—not just words.
howto.when_en: It triggers when your prompt contains “ultrawork” or “ulw”.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and fix the login endpoint bug.
say_en.note: Claude writes a failing check first, then fixes and shows runtime proof.

say_en.text: Start ulw and add a validation rule to the order module.
say_en.note: It plans, logs progress, and completes step by step.

say_en.text: Refactor this code in ultrawork mode and prove behavior is unchanged.
say_en.note: It pins old behavior, refactors, and verifies.
